source.title: XCITY Whitepaper V7
source.scope_warning: Page 4 uses about 400000 hectares. Do not transfer its absolute areas, 600 GW or long-term population to the current issued competition boundary.

interpretation: The whitepaper describes approximate functional-region shares in its older scope. The current competition retains these as a strategic reference: systems can overlap, particularly solar and agriculture. Compare exclusive base-land areas separately from overlapping functional coverage; do not enforce 60/30/5/3/2 as five exclusive quotas.
confirmed_programme: Photovoltaic agriculture leads the productive territory
Compute campuses use industrial halls with modular construction and equipment
Current issued boundary and both fixed pilots remain authoritative
deviation_policy: Every design must respond to the common five-function programme and approximate reference balance. Designers may freely explore other distributions, explaining material changes through terrain, drainage, usable land, population/jobs, facility demand, resources, access and construction phases. A coloured strategic region does not establish serviced, installed or commissioned area.
unknowns: Local crop yields and irrigation needs
